diagnosis: NOP fetch traps with `TRAP: cpu trap asserted` and `FAIL 0xdead` instead of progressing. picosoc/picosoc.v:127 and picosoc/picosoc.v:130 show mem_ready/mem_rdata combinationally valid during mem_xfer, so fresh mem_rdata is expected. picorv32.v:384 selects mem_rdata_q when (mem_xfer || LATCHED_MEM_RDATA) and mem_rdata otherwise, using stale data on the transfer cycle and decoding garbage to trap.
reason: Diagram shows fresh mem_rdata valid during mem_xfer while the mux selects stale mem_rdata_q, causing illegal decode and trap, confirming the swapped ternary.
